From Hanamkonda / Warangal via Bhupalpally & Mahadevpur
From Sircilla / Vemulawada via Karimnagar & Manthani

how_to_reach: Kaleshwaram is well-connected by road, with the nearest railway options around 65-75 km away and the nearest major airport at Hyderabad.

nearest_railway_station.name: Ramagundam (RDM)
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Also near Peddapalli (PDPL, ~75 km), Mancherial (MCI, ~70 km), and Warangal/Kazipet (~110-130 km)

road_routes: Regular TSRTC bus transportation connects Kaleshwaram to Manthani, Godavarikhani, Karimnagar, Hanamkonda (Warangal), and Bhupalpally.
parking_info: Ample parking is available at the TG Tourism Haritha Hotel and nearby areas.
